review_candidates.title: Senior Software Engineer (Control Plane + Orchestration) - Remote - Latin America
review_candidates.description: About FullStack FullStack is your AI-native engineering partner, built to turn AI capability into certainty. Most companies can demo AI; few can get it to production and prove what it produced. We close that gap with three capabilities, AI built into your products from the start, elite vetted talent who apply it, and transparent execution that shows value every step of the way. With now over 600 customers in North America, FullStack is one integrated partner for all your AI engineering needs. With FullStack, you move forward with confidence. We’re Most Proud Of Offering life-changing career opportunities to talented software professionals across the Americas. Building highly-skilled software development teams for hundreds of the world’s greatest companies. Having delivered hundreds of successful custom software solutions, which have positively impacted the lives and careers of millions of users. Our 4.1-star rating on GlassDoor. Our client Net Promoter Score of 68, twice the industry average. The Opportunity Join our talent network and connect with U.S. clients for flexible, project-based development work as a Senior Software Engineer. You will integrate directly into our client's team and work alongside their existing designers and engineers on a daily basis. What We're Looking For 5+ years of professional software engineer, control plane & orchestration experience. Advanced English is required. Successful completion of a four-year college degree is required. Demonstrated experience designing and building large-scale distributed systems. Proven experience developing platform APIs that are consumed by multiple internal or external engineering teams. Strong experience designing RESTful APIs with emphasis on reliability, consistency, idempotency, and versioning. Demonstrated experience building event-driven or message-driven architectures. Strong understanding of asynchronous workflows, orchestration patterns, and distributed coordination. Proven experience designing highly available backend services. Strong expertise with Kubernetes, including Operators, Controllers, and Custom Resource Definitions (CRDs). Demonstrated experience managing multi-tenant Kubernetes environments. Experience deploying and operating cloud-native applications in production. Proven experience designing storage solutions utilizing object, file, block, or container storage. Strong understanding of distributed system consistency models, fault tolerance, and failure recovery. Practical experience implementing observability using metrics, logging, tracing, and monitoring solutions. Experience collaborating closely with Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) teams. Hands-on experience implementing Infrastructure as Code (IaC) solutions. Solid background working with GitOps deployment methodologies. Deep experience working with air-gapped or highly regulated Kubernetes environments. Hands-on experience building orchestration platforms for distributed infrastructure. Solid understanding of networking infrastructure, service meshes, or proxy architectures. Familiarity with multi-cluster Kubernetes deployments. Experience building internal developer platforms or platform engineering solutions. Knowledge of cloud-native storage technologies. Ability to work through new and difficult issues and contribute to libraries as needed. Ability to create and maintain continuous integration and delivery of applications. Forensic attention to detail. A positive mindset and a can-do attitude. Experience working on Agile / Scrum teams. Meaningful experience working on large, complex systems. Ability to take extreme ownership over your work. Every day is a challenge to ensure you are performing to the expectations you and your team have agreed upon. Ability to identify with the goals of FullStack's clients, and dedicate yourself to delivering on the commitments you and your team make to them. Nice To Have We’re Seeking Engineers Who Are AI-enthusiastic In Their Workflow. Professional Experience Or Personal Project Work With The Following Is a Significant Plus Cursor, Windsurf, or Google Antigravity. Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Codex, or Copilot CLI. Work Authorization Requirements Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the country of this job posting on a full-time basis. FullStack will not sponsor applicants for work visas now or in the future. What We Offer Competitive pay. 100% remote work. The ability to work with leading startups and Fortune 500 companies. Continuing education opportunities. Opportunity to grow and expand your career. Our talent network is committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and accessible environment where IT professionals can find opportunities that match their skills. We welcome individuals of all races, religions, genders, sexual orientations, national origins, abilities, and experiences. Our focus is on connecting talent with projects based on qualifications, ensuring a fair and transparent process that values diverse perspectives and global collaboration. Learn more about our Applicants Privacy Notice.

review_candidates.title: 🇫🇷 Sales Engineer/Account Manager (France Market Expansion)
review_candidates.description: 💼 We’re hiring: Account Manager Fractory is transforming how manufacturing gets done and as WE EXPAND TO FRANCE , we’re looking for Account Managers who are ready to help us break into a new, high-potential market. This is a rare opportunity to join early, build the foundation, and shape how we grow in France from day one. We’re looking for someone who thrives in a fast-paced sales environment, builds strong customer relationships, and knows how to uncover opportunities others miss. You’ll work with engineering clients, drive outbound sales, and collaborate closely with our technical and commercial teams to keep deals moving and value high. 👉 Our product-market fit is strong. Now we need someone who takes ownership and pushes growth in a new country. If you’re driven by targets and excited to build something from the ground up, this role is for you. 👀 You’ll love this if you… Have strong outbound sales experience and know how to grow revenue (not just maintain accounts) Speak French and English fluently (Estonian is a nice plus but not required) Bring iengineering or manufacturing understanding Are structured but move fast, think practically, and don’t overcomplicate Are excited about opening a new market and building something meaningful Can work from our Tallinn or Tartu office at least part of the week ⭐️ Bonus points if you… Have worked with French customers or in the French market Hands-on experience with Sheet metal or CNC Have startup or industrial platform sales experience 🛠 What you’ll do: You’ll be the go-to contact for French accounts from prospecting to onboarding to growing long-term relationships. You’ll collaborate closely with our Project Engineers and operations team to deliver high value to clients. Your day-to-day includes: Hitting monthly, quarterly, and annual revenue targets Prospecting outbound via calls, emails, and social selling Building strong, long-term client relationships (including site visits when needed) Managing the full account lifecycle: onboarding, upselling, issue resolution Working closely with Project Engineers and Estimators Acting fast and practically to keep deals moving Handling payment terms, disputes, and flexible payment plans Keeping CRM (Salesforce) and the Fractory platform clean and up to date Understanding customer buying patterns and finding new growth opportunities 🎁 What you get: 💸 Competitive salary + commission 📈 Equity options 💆‍♂️ Stebby 100€/quarter wellness benefit 🏥 Private health insurance via Confido (coverage up to 10,350€/year) 🎉 International team, modern tools, and a mission you can believe in 📅 Hiring process (quick & clear): 30-min deep dive with Joosep (Co-Founder / Nordics Sales Director) Tallinn or Tartu office meet-up, presentation, and team meet 30-min call with our Head of People Final 30-min call with leadership We keep the entire process smooth and respectful of your time expect 2–3 weeks from first chat to offer. 📬 Ready to apply? At Fractory, we value quality, ownership, and courage. If you love solving real-world problems, learning fast, and driving meaningful results, you’ll feel right at home.

review_candidates.title: Solutions Consultant
review_candidates.description: We are seeking a Solutions Consultant to join our Revenue & Operations team in Vilnius. In this role, you will be responsible for fostering customer success across the DACH region by understanding clients' business needs and demonstrating how Adform's innovative products can help them achieve their goals. As a Solutions Consultant, you will work closely with German-speaking clients and stakeholders, providing onboarding, strategic consultation, and ongoing support to help them maximize the value of Adform's solutions. You will be self-sufficient in managing both internal and external stakeholders but will also require guidance and direction from your direct manager. Your exceptional onboarding experience, proactive support, and strategic consultations will enhance customer relationships. We hope you are ready to change the game! Be ready to: Understand the customers business needs and how Adform products help customer reach their goals. Drive Adform's commercial success by retaining and growing customer relationships and increase relevant product adoption. Be a proactive advisor towards the customer, consult on best practice solutions to meet their goals & objectives. Manage new client onboarding and new product rollout for existing clients, ensuring successful delivery within agreed timelines & technical specifications. Represent the client needs towards Adform product teams and collaborate with account management and customer success leadership to efficiently escalate relevant topics. Proactively educate customers, ensuring optimum platform knowledge and usage on the local market. Attitude First. Everything else will follow. We can grow together faster if you have: Strong interpersonal and networking skills, with the ability to influence key technical stakeholders both internally and externally. Excellent storytelling and presentation skills. Good understanding of digital marketing, programmatic media buying, associated tools, and the local competitive landscape, with the ability to identify and leverage USPs against competitors. Professional working proficiency in German (B2-C1 level) and fluent English enabling effective communication with clients and stakeholders across markets. Ability to present solutions assertively and translate technical details for non-technical audiences. Eagerness to gain broad knowledge of all Adform products and how they can help customers achieve their business goals. A strong desire to understand Adform’s internal processes, collaboration best practices, available resources, and to build a robust network with senior stakeholders across regions and functions. Adform’s guiding principles ingrained in your profile: Focus on Client Value, Behave with Decency, Take Ownership, Care, Collaborate as a Team Player, Remain Ambitious, and Stand Tall in all interactions. Our promise to you: A dynamic, inspiring, and international environment filled with ambitious and caring colleagues. A competitive compensation package ranging from €2500 to €3200 gross per month, with the final offer determined based on your qualifications and experience, plus annual performance-based bonus. Family benefits: four additional vacation days per year to enjoy life outside work, two weeks paid paternity/maternity leave. Comprehensive healthcare benefits: private medical insurance (after probation period), accident insurance. Yearly learning budget. Employee lunch discount in the on-site canteen. Parking space upon request. Leisure and game zones, on-site gym. Engaging social initiatives and company events to connect with colleagues and have fun. And much more – join us to explore the full experience! Diversity & Inclusion @Adform: Adform is an equal opportunity employer with a global perspective. We remain committed to creating an environment that not only respects different backgrounds but celebrates them too. We believe that diversity in all its forms enhances our teams’ creativity, innovation, and effectiveness, and therefore we value different backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. We are committed to creating a work environment where Adform employees feel valued for who they are and what they can contribute, free from any type of discrimination.
